title: Meaning Reaches Object Choice but Not Completion: Where Is a VLA Vulnerable to Landmark Synonyms?
abstract: arXiv:2611.24076v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: VLA policies are fragile to rewording. Success rates alone cannot say whether a policy fails to choose the object or to complete the task, nor where in the policy to intervene. We study the released GR00T N1.7 on two LIBERO-Spatial tasks differing only in the landmark word telling which of two bowls to take. Synonyms absent from the training instructions send the policy to the bowl they name, unlike made-up words, yet complete 67.6% of one task's closed-loop episodes, against the original word's 100%. Before the connector between the vision-language model and the action generator, replacing only the landmark tokens' vectors with the other landmark's (pasting) sends nearly every episode to the other bowl. After the connector, pasting at the landmark, the remaining instruction, or the image tokens alone rarely moves the choice, but any two do. translated_title: 语义能影响物体选择却无法影响任务完成：VLA在何处易受地标同义词的攻击？
translated_abstract: VLA（视觉-语言-动作）策略对措辞改写十分脆弱。仅凭成功率无法判断策略究竟是没有选中正确的物体，还是无法完成任务，也无法指出应在策略的哪个环节进行干预。我们在两个仅在“取两个碗中的哪一个”的地标词上存在差异的LIBERO-Spatial任务上研究了公开发布的GR00T N1.7。与虚构的词汇不同，训练指令中从未出现过的同义词会将策略引导至其所指代的碗，但在一项任务的闭环测试中仅完成67.6%的回合，而使用原始词汇的完成率为100%。在视觉-语言模型与动作生成器之间的连接器之前，仅用地标的token向量替换为另一个地标的向量（粘贴操作），几乎使所有回合都走向另一个碗。而在连接器之后，仅对地标token、其余指令token或图像token单独进行粘贴很少改变物体选择，但任意两者结合则会改变选择。在连接器之后对动作生成器隐藏地标token，仍会降低任务完成率。
tldr: 研究发现VLA策略能够理解训练指令中未出现过的地标同义词并将其语义用于物体选择（该语义作用点位于视觉-语言模型与动作生成器之间的连接器之前），但这种措辞改写会显著降低任务完成率，且连接器之后无法通过单独注入单个模态的token来改变选择。
en_tdlr: GR00T N1.7 VLA understands out-of-training landmark synonyms and uses their meaning for object choice at a locus before the connector between the VLM and action generator, but such rewording significantly degrades task completion, and no single token type pasted after the connector alone can change the choice.
